data.name: Precious
data.gender_notes: Precious is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘preos’ meaning ‘dear, valuable, precious’, the name Precious evokes feelings of worth and cherishing. In Christianity, the term is often used metaphorically for the value and worth of souls, as in ‘precious in the sight of the Lord’ (Isaiah 43:4). The name Precious carries the meaning “Valuable, dear, precious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Precious usually hope their child will grow to embody valuable, dear, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's love and worth placed upon all creations.
data.etymology: Precious belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Valuable, dear, precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Precious total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: עיקרית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עיקרית נגזר מהמילה העברית 'יקר', שפירושה הוא בעל ערך רב, יקר ומיוחד. בהקשר המקראי, המילה 'יקר' מתארת דברים או אנשים שבעלי ערך רב ומשמעות רבה. השם עיקרית משמש כהגדרה למי שיקר ומיוחד בעיני אלוהים, ומהווה ביטוי לאהבה והערכה רבה.

in_greek.name: Τιμία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τιμία προέρχεται από το ελληνικό επίθετο 'τιμή', που σημαίνει αξία, τιμή και κύρος. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η έννοια της τιμής συνδέεται με την πνευματική αξία και την αγιότητα. Το όνομα Τιμία αποδίδεται σε εκείνους που έχουν υψηλή πνευματική αξία και θεωρούνται πολύτιμοι στα μάτια του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Pretiosa
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Pretiosa derivatur a Latino 'pretiosus', quod significat valde pretiosum vel magni momenti. In primitiva Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Pretiosa dabatur illis qui habebant magnam spiritualem aestimationem et in Dei oculis erant valde pretiosi. Nomen hoc exprimit excellentiam et singularitatem.

in_english.meaning: Of high value, loved and cherished deeply
in_english.long_meaning: The name Precious originates from the Hebrew and Greek roots, signifying something or someone of great value and price. Throughout Christian tradition, the name Precious conveys a sense of high esteem, spiritual significance, and deep affection. It symbolizes the preciousness of a person in God's eyes, often reflecting qualities of love, kindness, and devotion.
